name: Beacon Trusteeship Ltd
about: Established in 2015, Beacon Trusteeship Limited provides a range of trustee services, including Debenture Trustee, Security Trustee, AIF Trustee, ESOP Trustee, Securitization Trustee, Bond Trustee, Escrow Services, and Safekeeping.[1]
keyPoints:
Service Portfolio[1][2]
A) Debenture trusteeship: Assisting companies in issuance of any type of debenture, including non-convertible debentures.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 56.9 days to 33.6 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
